# all inc.

> All Inc. builds software, user interfaces and connectivity for creatives: advanced instruments for the artificial intelligence. Its platform lets an artist perform an arena show from a single device, covering playback, showfiles, vocal processing and visuals.

All Inc. has two offices: All Inc. Audio Ab at Hämeentie 135, Helsinki, Finland, and US & All Inc. at 470 Ramona St., Palo Alto, California, United States.

## Pages

- [Home](https://allinc.fi/): what All Inc. does, its platform, its work (interfaces, plugins and tools, creative ecosystems) and its addresses
- [Toolbox](https://allinc.fi/#toolbox): free browser tools for musicians — tuner, key and bpm finder, metronome, setlist, delay times, tone generator, transpose, stage timer
- [Privacy policy](https://allinc.fi/privacy/): how personal data is handled on the site and in the apps, EU/EEA and US rights, and how to request access or deletion

## Notes

- The website sets no cookies and runs no analytics or advertising trackers.
- The toolbox runs entirely in the browser; audio from the microphone or from files never leaves the device.
